support_scope.local_completion: The track now provides a local release evidence generator that emits JSON and Markdown reports from local metadata and mockable registry evidence.
support_scope.external_gate: not applicable for the generator itself; individual registry publication states remain governed by their registry tracks.
support_scope.runtime_support_claim: The generator records release evidence states and warnings only. It does not make package, registry, stream, or calculator support claims by itself.

description: Automate release and publication evidence so package, tag, docs, and registry claims are queryable and auditable.
